findings.reason: the section must name the second node's host, or the stated outcome of its own negative control is false and the node's gate cannot be satisfied as written.
findings.text: §3's negative control says a flock-only take "from that second process" must fail to observe the holder, but exclusive_lock takes flock before the record lock, so a contender on the same node DOES observe the holder through the flock half and the control reports held; only a contender on a different node reports free, which the section never requires, so the node either fails its own gate or ships a control that demonstrates nothing about cross-node exclusion

findings.reason: the node needs a different control (the holder's absence of the flock half, or a second node) or it will report a red or a vacuous green.
findings.text: §4 repeats the same single-node control for the plan-review dispatch lock, inheriting the same false expectation (a same-node flock-only contender sees the holder's flock), so its §4 done-when cannot be met by the test it describes

findings.reason: without a control §5's whole measure rests on assertions that hold on the unmigrated code, so the section cannot be closed on a verdict.
findings.text: §5's done-when lists five assertions but no negative control: nothing shows that the picker's new lock file actually excludes (a two-process picker test showing two whole lines passes whether or not the lock is taken), and nothing shows the catalogue refresh "reads the snapshot instead of fetching" would ever fetch without the lock
